scores.tell: Water caustics and white net frame are slightly crisp, but the surface finish is close to the real cards.
none. Thatch strands, wood and water have fine, quiet texture like the real swing and towel.
The orb's internal swirl is airbrushed and smeary. The big glass highlight is uniformly glossy. The gold stand is smooth plastic.
Soft, even matte plastic on the casing. The headphone and knob highlights are a little uniform. Otherwise clean and plausible.
The whole cactus is one glossy, inflated plastic with no spine or skin texture. It reads like the grade 1 cat.
The red nose cone and silver body are high-gloss with sharp specular streaks. The metal reads as chrome plastic.
Wood grain on the planks is fine and quiet. The rope has fine twist detail. The foam edge is a bit smooth.
Teal body, floor and buttons are uniformly smooth, soft plastic with no fine detail. It is slightly clay-like.
The rover body is uniform glossy plastic. Rubber tires and panels have little micro-variation.
Coral has chunky, repeated stipple dots and a clay or plasticine surface. The rocks are smooth.
